title: Reproducing Goncharova et al. 2011: oxygen exchange and interface growth under a hafnium silicate film

specimen.paper: “a stoichiometric Hf0.67Si0.33O2 film with a thickness of 27 ± 2 Å”, ALD at 600 K with O3
specimen.ours: FAMILY: HighK_HfSiO_Si; a 27 Å grid; FILM: Hf0.67Si0.33O2_27A (recorded)

specimen.paper: nominally “1 nm SiOxNy/Si(001)”; “27 Å Hf0.67Si0.33O2/6 Å SiOxNy” where the temperature series is discussed
specimen.ours: INTERLAYER: SiOxNy_6A (recorded); the program's interfacial oxide starts at zero
specimen.note: Our interfacial oxide thickness is only the oxide grown during the anneal. To compare with a measured interlayer, 6 Å must be added, and the nitrogen in it is not represented.

specimen.paper: “all nitrogen is confined within the interfacial SiOxNy layer”; its amount falls by about half over the anneal series
specimen.ours: not in our specimen or programs

specimen.paper: “16O atomic density of 10.3 × 10^15 atoms/cm2 in the as-grown Hf silicate films”
specimen.ours: C_tot = 3.815e22 cm^-3 over 27 Å = 1.03e16 cm^-2, STATUS sourced
specimen.note: The paper's 10.3 may include the interlayer's oxygen; ours puts all of it in the film.

specimen.paper: Si(001); doping and wafer not stated
not stated whether each temperature is a fresh sample
specimen.ours: each temperature is a fresh film

history.item: Silicate film by ALD on a 1 nm interlayer
history.paper: “Hf oxide and silicate films 2–3-nm thick were deposited on a 1 nm SiO2/Si(001) or 1 nm SiOxNy /Si(001) film using atomic layer deposition (ALD) at 600 K with O3 as an oxidation agent.”
history.ours: the starting film: 27 Å, oxygen density from the as-grown 16O content; the interlayer starts with no oxygen counted
history.note: The program's interface reservoirs start at zero, so the 6 Å of oxide already there is not in the specimen.

history.paper: “Nitrogen was introduced into selected samples by postgrowth anneal in NH3 (973 K, 60 s). As a result a 5:1 = O:N ratio was achieved.”
history.ours: not in our history or specimen
history.note: The film our data come from sits on SiOxNy. The paper does not say whether the anneal was applied to the interlayer or to the finished stack.

history.item: Brief anneal to remove surface carbon
history.paper: “(after having been annealed briefly at 523–573 K to remove surface carbon)”
“The sample was first stabilized at a temperature in the ∼763–1223 K range (measured by an optical pyrometer and or a K-type thermocouple)”, then the gas admitted
history.note: Time at temperature in vacuum before the gas is not given; a hafnium film can grow interfacial oxide in vacuum (the paper's own crystallization anneal adds 4 to 5 Å).

history.item: Anneal in ¹⁸O₂ at 763 K, 30 min, 0.01 Torr
history.paper: “at different temperatures (but with the same 18O2 pressure [0.01 Torr] and anneal time 30 min)”; 98% enriched 18O2
history.ours: RUN Anneal DURATION 1800 TEMP 489.85->489.85 AMBIENT mix:O2=1.316e-05
history.note: The stored recipe gives this step as dry oxygen at one atmosphere. Written here at the paper's pressure. No program reads the pressure, and the language cannot say that the oxygen is the 18 isotope: the program assumes it.

history.ours: the history ends when the anneal ends

history.item: Ion scattering, in the same vacuum system
history.paper: “An incident ion energy of 130.8 keV” H+; depth resolution about 3 Å at the surface and 8 Å at 30 Å depth
history.ours: the observables O18_film, O18_interface, O16_interface and the 18O fraction at three depths

steps.name: Nitride
steps.label: Ammonia anneal, 973 K, 60 s
steps.paper: “Nitrogen was introduced into selected samples by postgrowth anneal in NH3 (973 K, 60 s). As a result a 5:1 = O:N ratio was achieved.”

steps.label: Brief anneal to remove surface carbon
steps.paper: “(after having been annealed briefly at 523–573 K to remove surface carbon)”

steps.name: Stabilize
steps.label: Brought to temperature in vacuum
steps.paper: “The sample was first stabilized at a temperature in the ∼763–1223 K range (measured by an optical pyrometer and or a K-type thermocouple)”, then the gas admitted
steps.timing: Ramp rate and hold time before gas: not given

steps.timing: 30 min. The text gives the range of exposures as “5–30 min”, and Figure 2 uses 10 + 30 min on one sample
